header: CRC32 little-endian, then one flags byte
blank: both complete reads are all ff; defaults without warning or writes
corrupt: no valid CRC and some non-ff data; warn and use defaults; retain bytes
io_error: explicit diagnostic; recover from a readable valid slot if available
save: explicit env save only; write alternate slot, read-back compare, obsolete old flag and verify
boot_policy: reinstalled from firmware on every boot
updates: preserve runtime env; use exact pre-update runtime snapshot for old image digest
